geometry_edits.rationale: Slightly widen and thicken the bar while retaining the dominant elongated gesture and reducing the overly flat box impression.
Tune the scale to keep the mass grounded and continuous across views.
Deepen the courtyard cut so the ground threshold is clearly public and not just a surface notch.
Increase the void proportion to improve legibility of the central open space.
Maintain an access-aligned opening to the frontage side.

graph_edits.rationale: Recast the base bar as a more sectionally expressive profile instead of a plain scaled box.
Broaden the bar slightly and reduce the blocky proportion so the dominant mass reads as a more capacity-aware ground datum.
Strengthen the void as an explicit courtyard/carved threshold rather than a shallow subtraction.
Increase void depth so the public opening becomes more legible in all views.
Keep the access-aligned opening toward the verified frontage side.

rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one dominant elongated bar with a carved central void, so it clears the basic form-legibility gate and responds to the parcel and access edge in a usable way. The blue frontage edge is answered by an open seam/undercut rather than a sealed wall, which is appropriate for neighborhood living. However, the silhouette is still fairly box-like and the stepped/roof expression is weak in section, so it only partially captures the program's upper hierarchy and public-space richness. Overall it is program-plausible and repairable, with the strongest evidence in the courtyard logic and the weakest in sectional articulation.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise composed mass with a central void and an upper connector; strong neighborhood-civic threshold logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more complex than the candidate; towers/waterfront setting are not transferable.

warnings: The mass remains somewhat generic and rectilinear; it needs a stronger section or roof response to avoid reading as a simple extruded bar.
The central void is legible, but the active-ground condition could be more emphatic.
Avoid over-fragmenting the single bar into multiple unrelated pieces on the next revision.
